# TENET

> Verification-first, open-source TypeScript AI agent framework. Its guarantee: an agent turn either answers with a grounded, verified citation, or it abstains / hands off to a human — it never states a fact it cannot ground in a source. Anti-hallucination, source-grounding, capability-token tool sandboxing, and pre-tool-call governance are first-class layers, not bolt-ons. Apache-2.0, pre-1.0.

TENET is a framework, not a model: it does not train or fine-tune an LLM, it *calls* one and makes whichever frontier model you call provably more grounded. The core is a fail-CLOSED agent turn: `runAgent` (`packages/agent/src/orchestrator.ts`) drives `OrchestratorState` through a `@tenet/workflow` graph — inbound injection gate → retrieve + knowledge-boundary gate → cache re-verify → a decides-and-drafts Reasoner (grounded-or-abstain) → governance-gated tools → a fail-closed verifier → a single emit edge — with abstain/handoff carried as values (never thrown) and a top-level catch that fails closed on any error. The worst outcome of a turn is a human handoff, never an ungrounded fact.

Measured, not marketed: every capability below is code in the monorepo, every benchmark row is gated in hermetic CI on each PR, and doc numbers are checked against the live test suite (`pnpm counts:check`). The suite is 1312 tests across 98 suites, all green, over 63 workspace packages.

- [BENCHMARKS](docs/BENCHMARKS.md): the measurable targets per dimension and the hermetic-stub vs real-model measurement split (the CI gate runs a deterministic stub; real-model numbers come from a local runner with the operator's own key).
- [Roadmap](docs/ROADMAP.md): as-built status of every phase (the current-state banner is the canonical live status).
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md): the hardened-by-construction guarantees (no `pickle`-style deserialization, path allow-lists, parameterized queries, `Secret<T>` that refuses `JSON.stringify`) and how to report a vulnerability.
- [Changelog](docs/CHANGELOG.md): notable changes, newest first.

## Core concepts

- Grounded-or-abstain: there is no default `answer` in the Reasoner's result type; any ambiguity (parse failure, unknown action, refusal, abort, truncation, uncited draft) resolves to `abstain`.
- Single emit edge: a fact-bearing draft becomes a member-facing reply at exactly one call site (`verifyAndEmit`), reachable only past a fail-closed verifier, a grounded-citation guard (≥1 non-blank citation), and an outbound leak gate.
- Fail-closed verifier: an atomic-claim multi-judge with deterministic pre-checks (quote-grounding, numeric fabrication, and URL fabrication — a cited `http(s)://` URL absent from the sources fails) and an opt-in `failClosed` mode where extractor/judge infra failures resolve to not-supported instead of a spurious pass.
- Pre-tool-call governance (`@tenet/governance`): per-tool policy rules (deny / allow / require_approval), an idempotent approval gate, and a structured audit trail — the tool executor only ever sees policy-allowed calls.
- One canonical `ChatModel` contract (`packages/core/src/model.ts`): a messages array, a required `AbortSignal`, tool round-trips, and a lossless `StopReason` union — six model adapters (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Mistral, Ollama, Bedrock) speak it.

## What ships today

- Agent turn: `@tenet/agent` (runAgent graph), `@tenet/workflow` (steps/graph), `@tenet/harness` (compaction, todos, subagents).
- Answer quality/safety: `@tenet/verifier`, `@tenet/refine` (knowledge-boundary gate, repair loop, best-of-N, and a `groundedOrAbstain` reference orchestrator chaining them fail-closed), `@tenet/guardrails`, `@tenet/governance`, `@tenet/policy`, HHEM judge adapters.
- Retrieval/memory: `@tenet/retrieval` (BM25 + dense + rerank), `@tenet/memory`, `@tenet/memory-adapters` (mem0 / Letta / Zep), `@tenet/rerank-cohere`.
- Surfaces (adapters, injected transport): Discord, Slack, Telegram, Teams, web widget, REST, gRPC, Matrix, voice/Twilio. Ticketing connectors: Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk, ServiceNow. `@tenet/surface-core` adds a fail-closed grounded-render gate (an uncited fact-bearing reply → a safe fallback, never the ungrounded text).
- Ops: `@tenet/durable` (step-level replay + interrupt() HITL), `@tenet/rate-limit`, `@tenet/telemetry` (OTel GenAI semconv), WASM tool sandbox + wasmtime, on-prem Helm chart (`infra/helm/tenet`).
- Protocol interop: MCP client + OAuth gateway, A2A v1 (server + client), AG-UI, ACP.
